name: io.github.Servosity/warranty-mcp
title: Dell, Lenovo and Apple MCP
description: Dell, Lenovo and Apple warranty end dates for every client's devices, in one local mirror.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_DELL_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the WARRANTY_DELL_CLIENT_ID credential for the Dell, Lenovo and Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_DELL_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the WARRANTY_DELL_CLIENT_SECRET credential for the Dell, Lenovo and Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_LENOVO_CLIENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the WARRANTY_LENOVO_CLIENT_KEY credential for the Dell, Lenovo and Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_APPLE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the WARRANTY_APPLE_CLIENT_ID credential for the Dell, Lenovo and Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_APPLE_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the WARRANTY_APPLE_KEY_ID credential for the Dell, Lenovo and Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the WARRANTY_APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY credential for the Dell, Lenovo and Apple MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the Dell API root, and your Dell credential is sent to this host. Leave blank to use Dell's production URL.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the Dell token endpoint, and your Dell client ID and secret are sent to this host. Leave blank to use Dell's.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Scope sent when minting a Dell token. Leave blank unless Dell told you to set one.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on vendor requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: WARRANTY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
